title: Figure 8: Hyper-lens based on a converging array of metal wires (schematic and field plot)
description: Left panel is a 3D axis plot schematic of a cone of converging wires with an object at the tip (labeled "Object") and a magnified "Image" at the base. Right panel is a color field map plotted against X/L0 and Y/L0 showing circular wire cross-sections with red field arrows and a highlighted central object. Caption: "Figure 8. Hyper-Lens Based on a Converging Array of Metal Wires." noting the λ/25 object is magnified by a factor of 5x.
